tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Concrete job cards. For a count or salary question use get_job_market_snapshot. A search needs location, lat with lng, occupation, q, or company_sef. company_sef from find_companies combines with location, occupation, salary, feature and employment. Do not count jobs. jobs[] is one page, not a sample of the whole match, so do not rank employers, occupations or market shares from it. Cite a job by url, id, title, employer name and place. Cite matching_active_jobs with retrieved_at. Cite salary only when the salary object is present, with period, currency, sample_size and salary.updated_at. methodology_url belongs to aggregated interpretation. The page length is not the job count. Do not aggregate jobs into a market figure. Do not convert hourly pay to a month. Full job text is the canonical url with Accept: text/markdown.

location.description: Czech place name such as Olomouc.

lat.description: Latitude in degrees. Send together with lng.

lng.description: Longitude in degrees. Send together with lat.

radius_km.description: Radius in kilometres from 1 to 50. Default is 15.

occupation.description: Use the human occupation phrase directly, for example kuchař or účetní. Do not invent, slugify, or transliterate it. Or send an existing class slug such as vyroba. Class slugs: vyroba, remeslo, stavba, sklad, ridic, gastro, uklid, ostraha, prodejna, obchod, zakaznicka-podpora, administrativa, ucetnictvi, it, inzenyr, zdravotnictvi, pece, skolstvi, vedeni, zemedelstvi, marketing.

salary_min.description: Monthly CZK floor on stored monthly pay. Hourly rates are not converted and do not match.

salary_max.description: Monthly CZK ceiling on stored monthly pay. Hourly rates are not converted.

employment.description: One of full_time, part_time or contractor.

feature.description: Fact feature slug such as nastup-ihned. Occupation class slugs belong on occupation.

company_sef.description: Public employer slug from the company resolver. Do not invent it from a name.

page_size.description: Cards on one page, from 1 to 20. A value outside that range is rejected.

cursor.description: Value of next_cursor from the previous page.

Cite matching_active_jobs with retrieved_at. Cite salary only when the salary object is present, with period, currency, sample_size and salary.updated_at. methodology_url belongs to aggregated interpretation. The page length is not the job count. Do not aggregate jobs into a market figure. Do not convert hourly pay to a month. Full job text is the canonical url with Accept: text/markdown.

tools.name: get_job_public_content
tools.description: One public job as markdown. Returns id, url and markdown. The url is the canonical detail.

tools.name: get_job_market_snapshot
tools.description: Count and salary without cards. Prefer this when the user asks how many offers or what pay is offered. With no filters it is the whole public HitPrace dataset in the Czech Republic: active deduplicated offers on HitPrace.cz, not a census of every vacancy in Czechia, and it has no salary. company_sef is allowed. A missing salary object means the sample is unpublished. Cite a job by url, id, title, employer name and place. Cite matching_active_jobs with retrieved_at. Cite salary only when the salary object is present, with period, currency, sample_size and salary.updated_at. methodology_url belongs to aggregated interpretation. The page length is not the job count. Do not aggregate jobs into a market figure. Do not convert hourly pay to a month. Full job text is the canonical url with Accept: text/markdown.

tools.name: find_companies
tools.description: Resolve a human employer name. At most five profiles. Do not guess when several are plausible. A brand is not the legal employer.

q.description: Human employer name, at least 3 characters.

sef.description: Public employer slug, the last segment of the employer page.
